defmodule WebProxy.Router do use Plug.Router require Logger plug :match plug :dispatch @k8s_namespace System.get_env("K8S_NAMESPACE", "default") @service_mesh_enabled System.get_env("SERVICE_MESH", "true") == "true" # Security headers configuration loaded from ConfigMap defp load_security_headers do case File.read("/etc/config/security-headers.json") do {:ok, content} -> Jason.decode!(content) {:error, _} -> default_security_headers() end end defp default_security_headers do %{ "x-content-type-options" => "nosniff", "x-xss-protection" => "1; mode=block", "strict-transport-security" => "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains", "referrer-policy" => "strict-origin-when-cross-origin", "x-frame-options" => "SAMEORIGIN", "content-security-policy" => "default-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'" } end defp apply_security_headers(conn, headers) do Enum.reduce(headers, conn, fn {key, value}, acc -> Plug.Conn.put_resp_header(acc, key, value) end) end # Health check endpoint for k8s probes get "/healthz" do send_resp(conn, 200, "ok") end # Readiness probe get "/readyz" do send_resp(conn, 200, "ready") end # Main application endpoint serving the dashboard get "/dashboard" do headers = load_security_headers() conn = apply_security_headers(conn, headers) html_content = render_dashboard(conn) conn |> put_resp_content_type("text/html") |> send_resp(200, html_content) end # API endpoint for CLI tool status get "/api/status" do headers = load_security_headers() conn = apply_security_headers(conn, headers) status = %{ namespace: @k8s_namespace, mesh_enabled: @service_mesh_enabled, uptime: System.monotonic_time(:second) } conn |> put_resp_content_type("application/json") |> send_resp(200, Jason.encode!(status)) end # Embed endpoint - allows embedding specific widgets get "/embed/:widget_id" do headers = load_security_headers() # For embed endpoints, we need to allow framing by partner origins # Remove frame restrictions for embeddable content adjusted_headers = adjust_headers_for_embed(headers, conn) conn = apply_security_headers(conn, adjusted_headers) widget_html = render_widget(widget_id) conn |> put_resp_content_type("text/html") |> send_resp(200, widget_html) end defp adjust_headers_for_embed(headers, conn) do allowed_origins = get_allowed_embed_origins() origin = get_req_header_value(conn, "origin") case validate_embed_origin(origin, allowed_origins) do :valid -> headers |> Map.put("x-frame-options", "ALLOW-FROM #{origin}") |> Map.put("content-security-policy", "frame-ancestors #{origin}") :invalid -> headers end end defp get_allowed_embed_origins do case System.get_env("ALLOWED_EMBED_ORIGINS") do nil -> [] origins -> String.split(origins, ",") end end defp validate_embed_origin(nil, _allowed), do: :invalid defp validate_embed_origin(origin, allowed) do # Check if origin matches any allowed pattern if Enum.any?(allowed, &origin_matches?(origin, &1)) do :valid else :invalid end end defp origin_matches?(origin, pattern) do # Support wildcard subdomains like *.example.com regex_pattern = pattern |> String.trim() |> String.replace(".", "\\.") |> String.replace("*", ".*") Regex.match?(~r/^#{regex_pattern}$/i, origin) end defp get_req_header_value(conn, header) do case Plug.Conn.get_req_header(conn, header) do [value | _] -> value [] -> nil end end # Catch-all for the main app - serves SPA match _ do headers = load_security_headers() conn = apply_security_headers(conn, headers) conn |> put_resp_content_type("text/html") |> send_resp(200, render_spa_shell()) end defp render_dashboard(_conn) do "K8s Dashboard

Dashboard

" end defp render_widget(widget_id) do "Widget #{widget_id}

" end end defmodule WebProxy.Application do use Application require Logger def start(_type, _args) do port = String.to_integer(System.get_env("PORT", "4000")) children = [ {Plug.Cowboy, scheme: :http, plug: WebProxy.Router, options: [port: port]} ] Logger.info("Starting WebProxy on port #{port}") opts = [strategy: :one_for_one, name: WebProxy.Supervisor] Supervisor.start_link(children, opts) end end
